items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 初次见面，我是林尼的魔术助手，工作事宜请咨询林尼。观看演出请咨询售票处。找我？…请长话短说。
items.text_en: Pleased to make your acquaintance. I am Lyney's magic assistant, and if you have work-related inquiries, please ask Lyney. If you have questions related to seeing a magic show, please ask the ticket office. You want to talk to me? ...Then get to the point.

items.title: 闲聊·喝茶
items.text: 茶泡好了，接下来可以休息一会儿了。
items.text_en: Tea is ready, now it's time for a short rest.

items.title: 闲聊·哥哥
items.text: 林尼好像又在说什么奇怪的话了…真让人放心不下。
items.text_en: Seems Lyney is saying some strange things again... it's really worrying.

items.title: 闲聊·发呆
items.text: 进入待机模式…希望不要有人来打扰我。
items.text_en: Entering Standby Mode... I hope nobody disturbs me.

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 雨天适合发呆…
items.text_en: Rainy days are perfect for spacing out...

items.title: 雨过天晴
items.text: 这就天晴了，可惜。
items.text_en: The skies have cleared? What a pity.

items.title: 打雷的时候
items.text: 唔…耳朵疼。
items.text_en: Ow... that hurts my ears.

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text: 冷…把你藏到帽子里吧。
items.text_en: So cold... let's hide you in a hat!

items.title: 阳光很好
items.text: 太阳底下没有新鲜事…真是这样吗？
items.text_en: There is nothing new under the sun... Is that really true?

items.title: 刮大风了
items.text: 风里传来的气息…不，没什么。
items.text_en: *sniff* What's that on the breeze? ...Nope, it's nothing.

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 早安…充能尚未完成，即将再次休眠。
items.text_en: Good morning... Not fully recharged. Now snoozing again.

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 我习惯工作之前喝一杯茶，能转换心情，也能保持清醒。
items.text_en: I usually drink a cup of tea before work. Not only does it change my mood, but also helps me stay alert.

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 太阳下山之后，人们内心潜藏的欲望，就会浮上水面…我是说，晚上的演出会很精彩。要给你留票吗？
items.text_en: After the sun goes down, the desires hidden in people's hearts will rise to the surface... I mean, evening shows are spectacular. Should I reserve a ticket for you?

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 快睡吧，我还要处理白天没做完的事情…（还要把弄坏的吸尘器修好。）
items.text_en: Go to sleep, I still have some loose ends to tie up from work today... (I still have to fix the vacuum cleaner I broke.)

items.title: 关于琳妮特自己·魔术
items.text: 表演的时候，我一般担任林尼的助手，因为一直不说话也不做表情，有人以为我是魔术人偶…这种误解能避免不必要的交际，倒也不错。
items.text_en: During our shows, I'm usually Lyney's assistant. Because I never speak or change expressions, people often mistake me for a puppet... this kind of misunderstanding can prevent unnecessary social interactions, so it's actually quite nice.

items.title: 关于琳妮特自己·情报
items.text: 沉默有助于集中精神，看清有用情报。曾经来看演出的某位贵客，掏出了不属于他太太的手帕…至于情报的具体用途，嗯…就看那位大人的意思了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Staying silent is beneficial for maintaining focus and gathering intelligence. Once, a VIP audience member at our show took out a handkerchief that didn't belong to his wife... as for how such information is used, now... that depends on what Father wants.

items.title: 关于我们·倾听
items.text: 我不习惯主动表达，但应该算是个不错的听众。如果有什么烦恼，就来找我吧。我会为你保密。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I'm not accustomed to expressing myself, but I consider myself a good listener. If you have any troubles, come find me. I'll guard your secrets.

items.title: 关于我们·兴趣
items.text: 我曾经以为，金色的「太阳」和夜色的「暗影」，是无法互相理解的，可你身上有着奇特的复杂性，让我产生了不必要的好奇心…今后也让我继续观察你吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6I used to think that the golden sun and dark shadows of the night could never understand one another. But in you, I see a kind of strange complexity that has needlessly piqued my curiosity... I'll have to keep a close eye on you.

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 比起武力，我更喜欢用自己的眼睛掌握现状，找到合适的解决方法。不过，拥有力量就会拥有更多底牌，就能在危急情况下保护重要的人。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I prefer to use my eyes to understand the situation and find an appropriate solution, as opposed to using martial prowess. But having brute force as an option greatly increases the potential cards at your disposal, and enables you to protect those most important to you in a crisis.

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 泡茶是一件看似简单实则费心的事情，茶叶的品质、茶水的温度、冲泡的次数，只有所有的变量都控制恰当，才能泡出味道最纯正的茶。要来一杯吗？
items.text_en: Making tea looks simple on the surface, but it is actually quite complex. The quality of the tea leaves, the temperature of the water, the number of times to add water... Only when every variable is properly controlled can tea of the purest taste be brewed. Would you like a cup?

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 小动物们也会表达自己的情绪，如果仔细聆听的话就会知道它们现在的状态。对于小猫来说，「喵~」比起「喵喵喵！」，前者心情更好，这时候不管怎么摸它都不会逃走哦。
items.text_en: Animals can also express their feelings. If you listen carefully, you can tell what state they are in. For a kitty, "Meow~" means they are much happier than "Meow meow meow!", and in that situation, you can pet them as much as you want and they won't run away.

items.title: 关于林尼·默契
items.text: 我和林尼一直都待在一起，我们即使不开口也能明白对方的想法，所以单独相处时，他会比平时要安静。你问我他说的哪些是真话，哪些是假话？其实我都知道，但这是最高保密事项。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I have always been together with Lyney, and we can tell what the other is thinking without speaking. Thus, he tends to be more quiet than normal when we are alone. Hmm? Can I tell when he's lying or telling the truth? Of course I can, but this matter is top secret.

items.title: 关于林尼·担忧
items.text: 林尼平时总是自信不疑，做起事来游刃有余，或者说，他让所有人都以为他一直如此，所以在遇到麻烦的时候，他也总会想要一个人完美地解决…如果遇到这种情况，还请多多关照他吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Lyney is normally quite confident, and does everything with incredible ease... or at least, that's how he wants everyone else to see him. So when he runs into difficulties, he always wants to solve everything perfectly on his own... if this happens, please be sure to take good care of him.

items.title: 关于菲米尼
items.text: 他是个细腻温柔的孩子，却有些喜欢妄自菲薄…或许是和之前的经历有关吧。有时候他给我的感觉就像是林尼的反面…既然两边都是我的家人，意见不合时，我会负责弥合分歧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4He is a delicate and gentle child, but also tends to belittle himself... perhaps due to his previous experiences. Sometimes he feels like the antithesis of Lyney... but since they're both family, when their opinions clash, I will bridge their differences.

items.title: 关于「父亲」
items.text: 「父亲」表达爱意的方式…不一定能被每个人接受，但就是因为有「父亲」在，家…才得以为家。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "As Light Rain Falls Without Reason"Oh, how "Father" expresses love... well, not everyone can accept it. But it is only because of "Father" that home... can be called home.

items.title: 关于那维莱特
items.text: 最高审判官总给我一种奇怪的疏离感，明明言行谈吐都很谦和…还是说，他也不怎么喜欢跟人打交道呢？不过他和美露莘们说话的时候，倒是很亲切。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4The Chief Justice always feels strangely aloof, though his words are always humble... or perhaps he just doesn't like dealing with humans? After all, when he speaks with Melusines, he's actually quite friendly.

items.title: 关于芙宁娜
items.text: 芙宁娜大人的行为太难解读了，也观察不出什么有用的情报，总觉得她一举一动像是在扮演不同的人…不愧是神明，不能用普通人的角度来揣测。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Lady Furina's behavior is incredibly hard to explain, and I can't discern any useful intelligence from observing her. I always feel like her every move and action is an act, and she is playing different people... She truly is an Archon, one cannot apply the logic of ordinary humans to her.

items.title: 关于娜维娅
items.text: 虽然是「刺玫会」的新会长，作风却像邻居家爱管闲事的大姐姐呢。要是「家」里真有这么一位姐姐就好了…啊，这话好像不太合适…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "As Light Rain Falls Without Reason"Though she's the new president of Spina di Rosula, her style is more like the nosy big sister next door. If we really had a sister like her in the "House of the Hearth," that would be really great... I know I probably shouldn't be wishing for anyone to be an orphan, but...

items.title: 关于克洛琳德
items.text: 我曾经奉命观摩过她的决斗，仅仅是从旁观察，就能感觉到令人害怕的寒意…真不知道在决斗场上直面她会是什么感觉…嗯，希望这辈子都不要知道。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "As Light Rain Falls Without Reason"I was once ordered to observe a duel of hers. Even just as a bystander, the coldness radiating from her was absolutely chilling... I don't know what it would be like to face her directly in a duel, and I hope I will never find out.

items.title: 关于千织
items.text: 我跟林尼的演出服都是请她定制的。有一次林尼用小刀表演魔术，不小心划到了袖口，后来被她数落了好久…真可怕。幸好每次去她店里，都可以躲到林尼背后。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4The costumes Lyney and I wear for performances were specially tailored by Chiori. Once, Lyney was using a small knife for a magic trick, and accidentally cut the cuff of his sleeve a bit. She scolded us nonstop... it was scary. Luckily, I can hide behind Lyney whenever we go to her shop.

items.title: 关于夏洛蒂
items.text: 呃…我后来也被她抓着采访过几次。明明被林尼拒绝了那么多次，真是毅力可嘉…可惜她准备了这么多问题，我一个也没回答。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "As Light Rain Falls Without Reason"Uh... I was eventually cornered by her for interviews a few times. The way she persistently asked even after Lyney rejected her all those times, I really have to commend her perseverance. Too bad for her, though... despite preparing all those questions, I never answered a single one.

items.title: 关于艾梅莉埃
items.text: 这位香水设计师小姐的作品热门到需要凌晨排队抢购。但我对香水的味道太敏感，打出喷嚏来就太失礼了…所以只能绕着走。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Her perfume products are so popular that you have to get in line before the break of dawn to have a chance at snapping any up. However, I'm far too sensitive to the smell of perfume, and it's really rude to sneeze... so I have to take the long way around.

items.title: 想要了解琳妮特·其一
items.text: 如果要解释魔术，就会失去看表演的乐趣，人际关系也是这样，想了解我的话，不妨一点点收集信息，拼凑答案吧。
items.text_en: If you explain a magic trick, then the allure of the performance is lost. Personal relationships are the same. If you want to understand me, why not learn a bit at a time, and gradually piece together a complete picture?

items.title: 想要了解琳妮特·其二
items.text: 人是很复杂的生物，即便不是有意欺瞒，也会不自觉地隐藏自己的真实一面。虽然我总能注意到一些「多余」的细节，但除非必要情况，我不会拆穿别人的伪装。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3Humans are complicated creatures. Even when they are not doing so intentionally, they will still unconsciously hide their true selves. Though I can always notice a few "redundant" details, I won't expose their facades when it isn't necessary.

items.title: 想要了解琳妮特·其三
items.text: 魔术曾经是我和林尼的谋生手段，现在更多是一种便利的社会身份，以魔术表演的名义，我们就能融入这座城市，成为家的「眼睛」。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "As Light Rain Falls Without Reason"Magic shows were once our livelihood, but now they are more of a convenient identity to present to society. In the name of magic performances, we can easily gain more access throughout the city, and be the "eyes" of our House.

items.title: 想要了解琳妮特·其四
items.text: 在来到新家之前，我和林尼一直到处流浪，经历了许多艰难和危险的状况。从那时起，我便习惯时刻注意一切危险的迹象，也逐渐学会解读他人的所思所想。好在，如今我们拥有了一个安身之所。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5Complete "As Light Rain Falls Without Reason"Before Lyney and I came to our new home, we were constantly adrift on the streets. We experienced many hardships and dangerous situations... It was then that I developed the habit of paying attention to any sign of danger, and also gradually learned to understand what others were thinking. Fortunately, we now have a safe place to live.

items.title: 想要了解琳妮特·其五
items.text: 建立人际关系是一种赌局，无论掌握多少信息，都难以预测人心的变化。一直以来我习惯待在安全的距离，但如果是你的话…我愿意承担输掉的风险。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Building a relationship with someone is like gambling. No matter how much information you have, it's hard to predict how other people might change. I've always had the habit of keeping a safe distance from others, but in your case... I'm willing to shoulder the risk of losing a bet.

items.title: 琳妮特的爱好
items.text: 人的精神和弓弦一样，如果一直绷得太紧，就会有断裂的风险。所以在工作之外，我会做一些能放松神经的事情，比如泡茶、喂猫、发呆。平时心情越是平静，就越能应对将来的危险。
items.text_en: A person's mental state is like a bowstring. If it's constantly under high tension, it will be at risk of suddenly snapping. So outside of work, I prefer to do things that relax my brain, like making tea, feeding cats, and just zoning out. The calmer one normally is, the easier it is to deal with crises when they do pop up.

items.title: 琳妮特的烦恼
items.text: 我不是很习惯操作机械，一旦不注意就会出现意外状况，有一次在雨天搞坏了烘干机…还好菲米尼很擅长修理东西。
items.text_en: I tend to have difficulties operating any kind of machinery. As soon as I stop paying attention, all kinds of things start to go wrong. Once, I even broke the dryer on a rainy day... At least Freminet is good at fixing things.

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 撬开贝壳，在新鲜贝肉上挤点柠檬汁，连餐盘都不需要了。完美。
items.text_en: Pry open the shells, squeeze a bit of lemon juice onto the fresh shellfish... no plate necessary. Perfection.

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 调料过重的食物，不行。食材就是要保留原始的口味才好。
items.text_en: Dishes should not be over-seasoned. Good food preserves the original taste of the ingredients.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 好吃，配方我已经记下来了。
items.text_en: Delicious. I've already memorized the recipe.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 谢谢招待。
items.text_en: Thank you for your generosity.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 调料的比例，再斟酌一下吧？
items.text_en: Perhaps you could reconsider the spice ratio a bit?

items.title: 生日
items.text: 生日快乐！卡片给你…这不是贺卡，当然没写东西了。写下你想要的礼物，放进我的帽子里，不管是什么，都会为你准备的。
items.text_en: Happy Birthday! Let me give you this card... it's not a greeting card, so of course nothing's written on it. Write down what kind of present you want, place it in my hat, and no matter what it might be, you'll get it.

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 感知更敏锐了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 1My perception has been heightened.

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 思考速度…继续上升。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 2My processing speed... has become even faster.

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 看到了，胜利的条件。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 4I can see the conditions for victory now.

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 我竟然能获得这样的力量…这样我也能站在你的身前了吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 6I never imagined I could become this powerful... looks like I won't need to hide behind you anymore.

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 一点把戏。
items.text_en: Step on up!

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 在这里。
items.text_en: Over here.

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 惊喜。
items.text_en: Surprise!

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 魔术开场。
items.text_en: Let the magic begin!

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 来点灯光。
items.text_en: Cue the spotlight!

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 请看这边。
items.text_en: Be amazed!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 宝物的气息。
items.text_en: The scent of treasure.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 不出所料。
items.text_en: Just as I expected.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 轻松到手。
items.text_en: Piece of cake!

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 保持冷静。
items.text_en: Stay calm.

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 我得集中精神。
items.text_en: I need to focus.

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 启动应敌模式…
items.text_en: Entering Combat Mode...

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 快退后。
items.text_en: Take a bow!

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 我来吸引火力。
items.text_en: Let me take the heat!

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 我…看漏了什么…
items.text_en: What detail... did I miss...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 魔术失误了…
items.text_en: Saw through... my trick...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 林尼…
items.text_en: Lyney...

items.title: 普通受击·其一
items.text: 还好。
items.text_en: I'll live!

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 啊，没躲开。
items.text_en: Ah, didn't quite dodge it.

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 魔术要开演了吗？
items.text_en: Is it time for a magic show?

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 下午茶时间到了。
items.text_en: Time for afternoon tea.

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 你带路吧。
items.text_en: You lead the way.
